primaryQuery:
run: order_items -> {
  where: created_at >= @2022-01-01
  group_by: mo is created_at.month
  aggregate: sales is sale_price.sum()
  order_by: mo
  calculate: cume is sum_cumulative(sales)
} -> {
  where: cume >= 4000000
  select:
    crossing_month is month(mo)
    cume_at_crossing is round(cume, 2)
    prev_month_cume is round(cume - sales, 2)
    short_of_4m_prior_month is round(4000000 - (cume - sales), 2)
  order_by: crossing_month asc
  limit: 1
}
variesAxis: self-join: cumulative as sum over earlier months via inequality join
